title: SM64DS Co-op 0.5.6 preview — Lua mods, SM64 camera and pause menu
notes:
This Windows preview adds **DS Lua mods**, an editable **SM64 Movement mod**, **C-Up inspection and Lakitu/Mario camera modes**, an adventure **Start/Resume menu**, and **texture pack creation tools**.

Open `sm64ds coop.exe` directly. Extract the portable ZIP alongside your existing game data, retaining saves and settings. It includes `mods/sm64-movement/main.lua`, `mods/resource-packs` and `texture-work/capture`; existing edited mods should be retained. The EXE creates the movement script if absent and never overwrites edits. The download includes no cartridge data, original textures, music or saves.

**Mods:** put `mods/<name>/main.lua` beside the EXE, enable it in Mods, and use Refresh Mods after editing. The movement mod adapts Mario walking/turning and jump launches; disabling it restores DS movement. Gameplay Lua currently runs only in solo adventure because co-op rollback does not snapshot Lua state. CoopDX scripts need adapting to the [DS API](https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/blob/ac0a066195292a95e827f80dc305a0dc8648d280/port/docs/ds-lua-api.md).

**SM64 Cam:** select Options > Camera > SM64 Cam. Q/E rotate, F zooms out, R returns near and then enters C-Up inspection while standing still. WASD looks around; jump/attack exits. V or right-stick click switches Lakitu/Mario. Mario stays visible; N64 distances/look limits use DS collision geometry, without N64-specific level camera volumes. Enter/Escape/controller Start opens the adventure pause menu.

**Textures:** Mods > Texture Pack Tools > Start Texture Capture; play the areas to edit, then Create Pack From Capture. Edit the generated PNGs in `mods/resource-packs/my-texture-pack-NNN/assets` and restart. Existing packs are never overwritten. Publish your replacement artwork rather than unedited captures.

Validation on source `ac0a066195292a95e827f80dc305a0dc8648d280`: full Windows game build and DS-state/face-cycle/ARM9-global/gxbank/tail-jump guards passed; 12 new actual-game checks plus music/SFX, custom media and the complete original DS Staff Roll cycle passed. Eleven local component checks, three archive-contract checks and all nine [desktop/Windows-host/mobile-component CI jobs](https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/actions/runs/38062581158) passed. Rendered Mods, Texture Packs, Pause and Mario camera captures were inspected.

**Platform status:** this release is Windows x86. Full Linux/SteamOS, macOS, Android and iOS game apps remain unfinished; the [native foundation contribution](https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/pull/8) and component/core builds are not playable packages or touchscreen device tests. Fresh-folder import, save loading, two-client co-op and return-to-menu need further runtime verification. Existing unrelated repository CI failures remain documented in PR #5.
